intro: Outback Steakhouse is an Australian-themed American steakhouse best known for the Bloomin' Onion, hand-seasoned steaks and warm bread. Like most steakhouses its entrees come with two sides, so the plate price is close to what you actually pay. The Center-Cut Sirloin and the weekday lunch menu are the value picks, while the ribeye, filet and seafood sit at the top end. Below is the full Outback Steakhouse menu with prices and calories for 2026, broken down by category.
quick_answer: The 6 oz Center-Cut Sirloin is around $16.79 and comes with two sides. The famous Bloomin' Onion appetizer is about $9.99. Alice Springs Chicken is around $20.99, and most locations run an Aussie 3-Course value deal plus a weekday lunch menu starting near $9.99.
hot_deal: Aussie 3-Course deal: at participating locations you can get a starter or soup and salad, a choice of entree, and a dessert for one set price. It is a limited-time value, so the price and the choices vary by location. Dine Rewards members also earn points toward free food.

faqs.q: What is the Bloomin' Onion at Outback?
faqs.a: The Bloomin' Onion is Outback's signature appetizer: one large onion hand-carved to bloom like a flower, battered, fried until crispy and served with a spicy signature dipping sauce. It is around $9.99 and about 1,920 calories, so it is made to share.

faqs.q: What is Alice Springs Chicken at Outback?
faqs.a: Alice Springs Chicken is a grilled chicken breast topped with sauteed mushrooms, bacon, melted cheese and honey mustard sauce. It is around $20.99 for dinner (about 890 calories), with a smaller 5 oz lunch portion near $12.99.

faqs.q: Does Outback Steakhouse have a 3-course meal deal?
faqs.a: Yes. Outback often runs an Aussie 3-Course value deal that includes a starter or soup and salad, a choice of entree, and a dessert for one set price. It is a limited-time offer, so the exact price and choices vary by location and season.

faqs.q: What are Outback's lunch specials and lunch menu prices?
faqs.a: Most locations offer a weekday lunch menu with smaller portions at lower prices, starting around $9.99 to $12.99. Options include the soup and salad combo, a 6 oz sirloin, Alice Springs Chicken and the Outbacker Burger.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest steak at Outback Steakhouse?
faqs.a: The 6 oz Outback Center-Cut Sirloin is the lowest-priced steak at around $16.79. At lunch, a 6 oz center-cut sirloin is available for about $12.99.

faqs.q: Does Outback have a gluten-free menu?
faqs.a: Yes. Outback has a dedicated gluten-free menu that includes several steaks, grilled chicken, seafood, salads and sides. Ask your server for the current gluten-free menu, as item availability can change.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Outback Steakhouse?
faqs.a: The best known are the Bloomin' Onion, Alice Springs Chicken, the Center-Cut Sirloin, Aussie Fries, and the Chocolate Thunder from Down Under dessert.
